_comment: TARGET=fork (the default): an anvil fork OF BASE MAINNET at the block pinned in fork.config.json, served on chain id 31337. Everything that matters -- the Morpho Blue USDe/USDC market, the tokens, the Uniswap V3 route, the strategy parameters -- is shared with TARGET=mainnet and lives in fork.config.json, because this fork IS Base. Only what is genuinely local is below. This file reproduces the pre-TARGET behaviour of the deploy scripts exactly; changing a value here changes what the fork run does.
name: fork
description: anvil fork of Base mainnet at a pinned block

chain._comment: kind=anvil-fork is what unlocks the cheat-code branches in deploy/target.sh (impersonation funding, anvil_setBalance, anvil_mine) and the anvil.pid liveness check. No other target may set it.

rpc._comment: The anvil we start ourselves. FORK_PORT has always been the override and still is; apps/loop-server defaults VAULT_SERVICE_JSON to deploy/.fork/vault-service.json, which is why state_dir stays .fork.

service._comment: Every 10 seconds. Right for a fork: blocks are free, gas is free, and a demo has to show an attested strike inside a minute. This number does not travel to a live chain; see targets/mainnet.json. The two timeouts are how long the scripts wait for a strike to land, and they follow the cadence: 90s is vault-service.sh's original 18 x 5s budget, 60s is enter-loop.sh's original 12 x 5s.

keys._comment: The well-known anvil mnemonic: public, worthless, pre-funded on every anvil. Override with FORK_MNEMONIC if you want a different one. The role -> account-index map is the layout the scripts have always used: index 0 funds and owns, 4 is the strategist, 5 is the depositor. Mnemonic accounts on a Base fork originate transactions only (the well-known addresses carry EIP-7702 delegation code, which is inert for origination but makes them unusable as ECDSA signers, hence the ephemeral node keys in vault-service.sh). treasury shares index 0 and is unused on this target: fork funding impersonates instead.
keys.mnemonic_default: test test test test test test test test test test test junk

funding._comment: FORK-TRACK-ONLY FUNDING SCAFFOLDING, fenced behind fund_account() in deploy/target.sh. Tokens are taken by anvil-impersonating the largest USDC holder at the pinned block, which happens to be Morpho Blue itself; the address is read from fork.config.json via token_whale_config_path rather than duplicated here. Gas is conjured with anvil_setBalance. Never a mainnet pattern.
